title: Reclaiming Power over AI: Equipping Queer Teens as AI Designers for HIV Prevention

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: The authors propose a community-engaged methodology using an adapted PARQAIR-MH Delphi process, co-design workshops, and one-on-one usability testing with LGBTQ+ adolescents to actively exploit unintended harms, such as misgendering, and identify heteronormative and cisnormative biases in generative AI health assistants (e.g., ChatGPT).
